prepare_timeline_events: prepare a DataFrame of trace events for timeline plotting with auto-detected settings and symbol table decoding
plot_events_timeline: plot a timeline of GPU and CPU trace events using Plotly and save as HTML or image
align_module_with_kernels: align CPU module events with their corresponding CUDA kernels on a timeline using kernel start and span columns
Timeline_class: create a Timeline object from trace events DataFrame, apply optional filters, and plot the timeline with a title
TimelinePlotSetting_dataclass: configure timeline plot settings including event type, multi-rank, multi-stream, task height, and short event amplification
